mapper.select: select count(*) from team t left join team_penalty p on t.team_id = p.team_id and p.penalty_id = ( select max(p2.penalty_id) from team_penalty p2 where p2.team_id = t.team_id ) where (t.deleted = 0 or t.deleted is null) and ( #{status} = 'ALL' or (#{status} = 'PENALTY' and p.score != 0) or (#{status} = 'LIMITED' and exists ( select 1 from team_penalty s where s.team_id = t.team_id and s.cancelled_admin_id is null and (s.permanent_suspension = 1 or now() between s.suspension_start_at and s.suspension_end_at) )) ) and ( #{keyword} = '' or t.team_name like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') )

select t.team_id, t.team_name from team t where (t.deleted = 0 or t.deleted is null) and ( #{keyword} = '' or t.team_name like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') ) and ( #{status} = 'ALL' or (#{status} = 'PENALTY' and exists ( select 1 from team_penalty p where p.team_id = t.team_id and p.score != 0 and p.penalty_id = (select max(p2.penalty_id) from team_penalty p2 where p2.team_id = t.team_id) )) or (#{status} = 'LIMITED' and exists ( select 1 from team_penalty s where s.team_id = t.team_id and s.cancelled_admin_id is null and (s.permanent_suspension = 1 or now() between s.suspension_start_at and s.suspension_end_at) )) ) order by t.team_id desc limit #{row}, 10
select u.nickname from team_user tu join user u on u.user_id = tu.user_id where tu.team_id = #{teamId} and tu.team_role = '주장' and tu.withdrawn = 0 limit 1
select count(*) from team_user where team_id = #{teamId} and withdrawn = 0
select score, reason from team_penalty where team_id = #{teamId} order by penalty_id desc limit 1
select count(*) from team_penalty where team_id = #{teamId} and cancelled_admin_id is null and (permanent_suspension = 1 or now() between suspension_start_at and suspension_end_at)

select penalty_id, score, reason, received_at, report_id, suspension_start_at, suspension_end_at, permanent_suspension, cancelled_admin_id from team_penalty where team_id = #{teamId} order by penalty_id desc
mapper.insert: insert into team_penalty (team_id, received_at, score, reason, suspension_start_at, suspension_end_at, permanent_suspension) values (#{teamId}, now(), #{score}, #{reason}, now(), date_add(now(), interval #{days} day), 0)
insert into team_penalty (team_id, received_at, score, reason, permanent_suspension) values (#{teamId}, now(), #{score}, #{reason}, 0)
insert into team_penalty (team_id, received_at, score, reason, suspension_start_at, suspension_end_at, permanent_suspension) values (#{teamId}, now(), #{score}, #{reason}, now(), null, 1)
